source_name: FinStat.sk — vendor company profiles (revenue, filings, ownership)
why_relevant: Aggregator over SK registers; fastest way to size and track SK subsidiaries of banking-tech vendors and to find their legal names/IČO for register lookups.

source_name: Printec Slovakia — country site (ATM/POS/self-service portfolio and market position)
why_relevant: Printec is a principal SK channel for NCR ATMs and payment terminals; country page and its news items indicate portfolio moves and, occasionally, named SK bank/retail deployments. Peer-benchmark source.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf Investor Relations — press releases
why_relevant: Global ATM/branch-automation vendor; contract wins and managed-services deals (incl. CEE) are announced here and repeated on earnings calls. No SK-specific release surfaced in this pass, but the feed is the canonical place one would appear.

source_name: NCR Atleos newsroom
why_relevant: Atleos (ATM hardware/ATMaaS, being acquired by Brink's) announces European branch/ATM-as-a-service wins; SK deployments usually reach the market via partners like Printec, so vendor news plus partner news is the only public trail.

source_name: Euronet Worldwide IR newsroom — SK ATM outsourcing announcements
why_relevant: Euronet has publicly announced SK bank ATM outsourcing (Tatra banka, ~120 ATMs) — a concrete precedent that private SK bank estate deals do get disclosed in vendor IR feeds; also relevant for independent ATM deployment in SK.

source_name: Temenos — customer/region pages and press (Europe, CEE)
why_relevant: Temenos publicly names SK-relevant wins: Tatra banka selecting Temenos Multifonds for fund administration (Tatra Asset Management, DDS TB) and Temenos Core live across RBI subsidiaries incl. Slovakia.

source_name: Orion Innovation — Temenos partner/licensing announcements covering Slovakia
why_relevant: System-integrator press releases reveal which markets (explicitly Slovakia) a core-banking stack is being pushed into and who the implementation partner would be — an early indicator of pipeline before any bank announces.

source_name: SOFTEC s.r.o. — banking references (Tatra banka, Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, ex-Sberbank SK)
why_relevant: Local SI whose public references name the largest SK banks and describe digital-onboarding/digital-banking work — direct evidence of private bank IT programmes with no public tender record.

source_name: ANASOFT — Referencie
why_relevant: SK software house listing financial-sector references incl. digital transformation of banking processes; useful for mapping which niche systems SK banks buy locally.

source_name: DATALAN — Referencie (financial sector)
why_relevant: SK infrastructure/IT integrator with a 'Financie' reference vertical; useful for branch IT, self-service and infrastructure deals at SK banks.

source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) — contracts of state-linked banks/institutions with IT and ATM/POS vendors
why_relevant: Although private banks are out of scope for CRZ, state bodies, NBS-adjacent entities and state-owned banks publish full contract texts naming banking-tech vendors, prices and terms — a price/benchmark anchor for vendor deals otherwise invisible.

source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — Zmluvy, objednávky, faktúry (procurement disclosures)
why_relevant: Central bank publishes contracts, orders and invoices naming IT/cash-handling/card vendors; reveals vendor presence and pricing in the SK market and identifies vendor legal entities to track.

source_name: ATM Marketplace — vendor company news hubs (Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos)
why_relevant: Trade-press aggregator of ATM/self-service vendor announcements; efficient single funnel for spotting CEE/SK contract news that vendors publish only regionally.

source_name: PR Newswire — vendor contract announcements (Diebold Nixdorf and payment vendors)
why_relevant: Primary wire where ATM/payment vendors publish contract wins, including multilingual regional versions; searchable archive is a reliable net for any future SK bank win.

source_name: Worldline / Ingenico newsrooms (payment acceptance & terminals)
why_relevant: Terminal and acquiring-side vendor news; Worldline/Ingenico consolidation reshapes SK POS estates, and merchant-acquiring or bank terminal deals are announced here rather than in any SK public record.

source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (ZBK) — card and payments articles
why_relevant: Banking association content on card issuance/personalisation practice occasionally names technology and card-production practices across member banks; a pointer into which banks run which card programmes.

source_name: Nextech.sk — SK tech trade media covering card/payment technology vendors
why_relevant: SK-language tech press reports vendor product launches with SK banks (e.g. IDEMIA Touch Card coverage); often the only SK-language echo of a vendor announcement.

source_name: ebankomaty.sk — SK ATM estate directory
why_relevant: Directory of ATMs in Slovakia by operator/bank; useful to size and attribute estates and to detect operator changes that imply a new vendor/outsourcing contract behind the scenes.

source_name: Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ) — public register of financial statements, MF SR
source_subtype: official statutory register / bulk open data
why_relevant: Statutory central repository of all Slovak accounting units' financial statements and annual reports, including banks and payment institutions. Filings (PDF + structured) are back-filled and preserved even when an issuer removes them from its own site, so it is the backbone for multi-year time-series on SK bank/PSP financials.

source_name: FinStat.sk — Slovak company financial aggregator
source_subtype: commercial aggregator with API + bulk CSV datasets
why_relevant: Normalises RÚZ/ORSR/Obchodný vestník into per-company profiles with multi-year P&L and balance-sheet series, incl. banks, leasing and payment companies. Converts heterogeneous statement templates into one unified template — removes the hardest part of building SK bank time-series.

source_name: Ekosystém.Slovensko.Digital — open data & open API hub (SQL dumps of SK registers)
why_relevant: Civic-tech mirror that republishes RPO/RPO V2, RÚZ, CRZ and Obchodný vestník as documented tables, weekly SQL dumps and continuously-updated APIs. The single most efficient pointer for machine-readable SK corporate disclosure and the practical route to bulk data without scraping state portals.

source_name: data.gov.sk — central Slovak open data catalogue
why_relevant: National DCAT catalogue listing publisher datasets including registers of legal entities and financial statements; the canonical discovery layer for which SK public body publishes what, in what format, and how often.

source_name: NBS CERI — Centrálna evidencia regulovaných informácií (SK regulated-information archive)
why_relevant: Official OAM/archive of regulated information for securities issuers (annual and half-year financial reports, GM notices, capital changes) with historical depth back to June 2007. Several SK banks are bond/share issuers, so this is the authoritative archive of their periodic disclosures independent of their own websites.

source_name: NBS 'Informácie od emitentov cenných papierov' — historical/legacy issuer-information archive
why_relevant: NBS's own 'história' section retaining older issuer-information pages that predate or sit beside CERI — useful for recovering disclosures whose current links have been reorganised after NBS site migrations.

source_name: European e-Justice Portal — BRIS 'Find a company'
why_relevant: EU-level single access point querying the Slovak business register in real time and exposing the list of documents filed nationally, in EN. Useful for cross-border group mapping of SK bank subsidiaries/branches and for language-neutral identifiers (EUID) linking SK entities to parent groups elsewhere in the EU.

source_name: Obchodný register SR (ORSR) — statutory commercial register
why_relevant: Source-of-truth entity layer (IČO, legal form, statutory bodies, shareholders, deposited documents) that every aggregator in this cell derives from; needed to anchor bank/PSP identities before joining financial time-series.

source_name: Register právnických osôb (RPO / RPO V2) — Statistical Office reference register API
why_relevant: Official REST API consolidating legal-entity data from the commercial, trade and association registers — the cleanest machine-readable identity backbone for SK entities, superseding older RPO datasets.

source_name: Obchodný vestník (Commercial Bulletin) — structured feeds via ekosystém mirror
why_relevant: Official gazette of corporate events (register changes, bankruptcies, liquidations, restructurings, capital reductions); the mirrored structured version turns free-text notices into trackable events for SK banking/payment entities. Complements filings with 'what changed and when'.
